say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Eyes up, all three of you! Tonight it is a full three-on-three bout against Pawmi, Starly, and Caterpie.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: We have been itching for a rematch all week! Watch out for my static, {partner}!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Keep your formation tight and stay sharp. I will call out pointers from the sidelines as you fight!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: We are ready, Dad! Let us show them our footwork, {lord} and {healer}!
